text: The BetCity bookmaker is operated by LLC Fortuna, controlled by LLC BetCity. Gorod N reported in February 2025 that founder Sergey Samsonenko's controlling 60% stake passed into a personal fund; 10% sits with the Lernako fund and 5% each with Leon Tiratsuyan and Andrey Kamenev. All owners reported are private.
short: BetCity is controlled via founder Sergey Samsonenko's personal fund and private partners.

source.name: Город N (gorodn.ru): Контроль за букмекерской сетью «Бетсити» передан в личные фонды
source.note: Rostov business paper citing SPARK-Interfax data. Translation: the controlling 60% stake in BetCity passed from Sergey Samsonenko into the personal fund Mak.
source.quote: Контрольный пакет акций «Бетсити» (60%) перешел от Сергея Самсоненко в личный фонд «Мак».
